incidents.what: s2-num-tasks.tsv at abdc88c5 passed --pairs values beginning with '-' as a separate token; argparse read them as options and the tool exited 2 before any unfold (lines 0-3, 14-16 in allocation 58904837; lines 25-27, 62-66 would have failed the same way). Queue runners stopped before allocations B, C and the GPU lane launched. Repair: --pairs=<value>. This is the one corrective resubmission permitted for the Stage-2 study tables (queues s2-cpu-r.q, s2-gpu-r.q).

study P (amendment 3) defect: s5p_universe --prior reweighted the MC truth/reco weights but not the truth denominator, so each prior-varied product was divided by its cells' mean prior reweight (a synthetic constant reweight of 1.3 reproduces a factor 1/1.3). Found by a development cross-check before any use: restoring the reweight per cell makes the data shifts correlate 0.88-0.96 with minus the pseudo-experiment bias. Repaired (prior_inputs reweights the denominator by ofin_r/ofin), regression test red on the defective form; the five prior products d1-d5 of job 58906549 are superseded and re-run once (the corrective resubmission for study P); d0 and the CV control are unaffected (r = 1).

study K: the B0 departure traces (58904830_1-4) ran past 9.4 h against a 10 h limit sized from the nominal trace (8.2 h); the tracer writes only at the end. Prepared the corrective resubmission (s2-conv-b0r-tasks.tsv, queue s2-conv-r.q: 24 h limit, per-iteration checkpoints at k = 10...175 via s5p_converge.install_checkpoints), launched only after the original tasks leave the queue; a line whose product exists is skipped.

study I: the detector dump (58917890_0) refused to write, as designed: the current collector drops the 2,801 truth-sentinel rows the older npz keeps (32,846,302 vs 32,849,103 rows). Repaired: align on the npz's non-sentinel rows, verify equality there, keep the sentinel rows at CV weights (declared); re-run alone (s2-dump2-tasks.tsv). The lateral pilot (58917890_1) completed in 12 min (1.55 GB npz). Consequence recorded for Stage 4: lateral endpoint npz files lack the sentinel rows, so a lateral band's shift must be taken against a CV product without them.

study K capacity probe: the 100-iteration array (58904836, 16 h limit) has no checkpoints and may time out; a checkpointable 10-iteration run of the same probe (s2-conv-cap10-tasks.tsv; identical first 10 iterations by determinism) is queued on the GPU pool; the rule needs k <= 5 only (capacity affordable only at 5 iterations).

two cancelled arrays (58950326 pilot, 58953708 F4) could not close in the meter: tasks the scheduler had split off while pending (58950326_6/_7, 58953708_1) have no sacct row at all, so 'all tasks seen' never held; their reservations (8.75, 1.25) stayed charged and their concurrency (0.75, 0.5) held every new admission (2.6 of 2.0). all-band design pilot 58954259: 12 tasks FAILED ('lam < 0 or lam contains NaNs' in build_pseudo's Poisson draw; 5 products written), 48 pending tasks cancelled. Cause (measured by a scan of the 69 model universes): LowQ2_1 has negative weights on 462 rows (435 reco-passing, ratio down to -156) and HighQ2_1 on 99 rows (94, down to -18); the all-band draw includes one of them in half the experiments, the single-universe draw rarely did. Repair: a negative or non-finite combined factor is clipped to 0 and counted per experiment ('clipped_rows' in the draw; <= ~460 of 20.4M reco-passing rows); test. Not re-run in stage3_repair2 (its corrective resubmission was spent on the F4 lines): the V ensemble moves into production as its first job on its own seeds, used only for V (decision recorded for amendment 7; confirmation review before production)
